overview_description.description:
Treasury Prime is a Banking-as-a-Service company that connects banks and FinTechs through an API. Its full integration into core banking systems gives developers access to a wide range of banking services from opening accounts to making payments to issuing cards.

Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Treasury Prime is a Banking-as-a-Service company that connects banks and FinTechs through an API.

product.name: Bank OS
product.description: A cloud-based banking operating system that connects banks, fintechs, and enterprise companies through APIs to launch and manage embedded banking programs.

product.name: Treasury Prime API
product.description: A REST API for building embedded banking products, with access to accounts, transactions, payment rails, check deposits, cards, webhooks, and bank integrations.

product.name: Digital Experiences
product.description: Tools and integrations for creating branded digital banking experiences and embedding financial services into websites, applications, and other customer interfaces.

product.name: Payments
product.description: Embedded payment infrastructure for initiating and receiving ACH, card, check, wire, and other money-movement transactions through integrated banking APIs.

product.name: Accounts
product.description: An account and sub-ledger solution that supplements a bank’s core system and supports account creation, balances, transactions, and funds management.

product.name: Compliance
product.description: Compliance infrastructure and controls for monitoring embedded banking programs, managing risk, and supporting bank and fintech regulatory obligations.
